style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm playful kids-fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm sand beige #F2EFEA, marigold yellow accent #F5A623 and charcoal black #2B2B2B; bright natural sunlight with crisp soft shadows around 5200K in scenes and soft diffused high-key in detail shots; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info labels with circular numbered markers and marigold accent bars; consistent thin-line icon style; clean lifestyle kids fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable child-model scale in scene shots and stable garment scale in detail shots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
